settings.title: How to remind me
settings.subtitle: Find your own rhythm
settings.intervalHelp: Missed the message? The bot will remind you again after this interval.
settings.checkHelp: 20 minutes after “Done”, the bot will check in once: “Is everything done?” 💛
calendar.title: In your calendar, too
calendar.subtitle: Your plans, always close by
calendar.description: Subscribe once to see your reminders in your calendar app. Downloaded events and their alerts are available even offline.
calendar.instructions: On iPhone: Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar. Paste the link and turn off “Remove Alerts”. In other apps, look for a calendar subscription by URL.
calendar.copyManual: Select and copy the link above
calendar.resetConfirm: Create a new link? The old link will stop working. You'll need to subscribe to the calendar again.
calendar.privacy: Keep this link private: it gives access to your reminders.
about.title: About Napominalochka
about.subtitle: A little help with what matters
about.description: For big plans and little don't-forgets. Napominalochka makes room in your head for what matters to you.
form.eyebrow: Make a little room in your mind
form.description: What should we remind you about?
form.descriptionHelp: Use your own words — only you will see this message.
errors.descriptionRequired: Please enter what you'd like to be reminded about.
errors.dateRequired: Please choose a date and time.
errors.dateInPast: Please choose a time in the future.
errors.generic: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.auth: Please reopen the app through the bot in Telegram.
errors.telegramRequired: Open Napominalochka through its bot in Telegram so we know which reminders to show.
errors.notFound: This reminder has already been deleted. Refresh the list.
errors.invalidRequest: Please check the details and try again.
errors.calendarDisabled: Calendar subscriptions aren't available yet. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: A few too many actions at once. Give it a moment and try again.

yandex.title: Alice
yandex.subtitle: A gentle reminder out loud
yandex.description: Your speaker can remind you alongside Telegram.
yandex.step1: In Home with Alice, create a scenario for your speaker with the “Read text aloud” action.
yandex.phrase: You have a new reminder. Take a look in Telegram.
yandex.behavior: The phrase in your scenario plays once at the scheduled time. Follow-ups stay in Telegram.
yandex.permissions: Yandex requests permission to view and control your entire smart home. This is broader than the selected scenario; Napominalochka uses it to list scenarios and run the one you choose.
yandex.scenarioHelp: Choose an active scenario from your account.
yandex.loadScenarios: Refresh the connection to load scenarios.
yandex.noScenarios: There are no active scenarios. Create or enable one in “Home with Alice”, then refresh the list here.
yandex.testHelp: The test runs all scenario actions immediately. Listen to your speaker.
yandex.testSent: Request sent. Check whether the phrase played on your speaker.
yandex.notConnected: Connect the account used by your speaker.
yandex.returnHelp: After signing in, confirm the connection in Telegram and reopen the Mini App.
yandex.awaitingReturn: Finish signing in to Yandex and confirm the connection in Telegram. If your browser did not open, tap the connect button again.
yandex.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Yandex? Napominalochka will remove this connection and stop running your scenario. Your Telegram reminders will continue.
yandex.disconnected: Yandex is disconnected. You can also fully revoke access in your Yandex settings using the link below.
yandex.errors.notConnected: Connect your own Yandex account first.
yandex.errors.reconnect: Your Yandex connection expired or was revoked. Please reconnect your account.
yandex.errors.scenarioMissing: This scenario is no longer available. Refresh the list and select an active scenario.
yandex.errors.rateLimited: Wait a minute before running the scenario again.
yandex.errors.unavailable: Yandex could not be reached right now. Please try later.
yandex.errors.invalidState: The connection link has expired. Refresh the connection and sign in again.
yandex.errors.invalidSelection: Choose an active scenario from your own Yandex account.
yandex.errors.generic: That action with Alice did not work. Please try again.
yandex.errors.connect: Could not open the Yandex connection. Refresh the connection and try again.
yandex.errors.delivery: The last scenario run could not be confirmed. Check your speaker and connection.
yandex.errors.deliveryUncertain: Yandex did not confirm the run. The scenario may already have run, so check your speaker. It will not be retried automatically.
empty.scheduledDescription: Add a reminder for a time that suits you.
pending.title: Waiting to be done
pending.snoozed: Snoozed. The next message time has been updated.
pending.alreadyCompleted: This reminder is already done. The list has been refreshed.
yandex.fixedPhrase: Alice reads the fixed phrase in the scenario, not your reminder text. Audio plays only for the first delivery; snoozes and follow-up messages stay in Telegram.
yandex.actionsWarning: All actions in this scenario will run. Choose a scenario containing only the reminder actions you want.
yandex.heardPrompt: Did the phrase play on the right speaker?
yandex.checkSpeaker: Check the volume, speaker and “Read text aloud” action in the scenario. After checking, you can run another test manually.
